## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint`, `make test`, and `make test-e2e` pass.
- [ ] Persian and English text is complete and reads naturally.
- [ ] The privacy mode and the limitations of each changed tool are accurate.
- [ ] No input, output, or file name leaves the browser. No new storage key.
- [ ] New shipped packages are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with their license.
- [ ] The tool has an example input and a short usage text in both languages.
- [ ] I tried the change at a phone width (about 375 px).
- [ ] `README.md` or `docs/` describe any changed behavior.
